verdict.rationale: Cloudflare exposes a full OpenAPI spec, granular API tokens, and a CLI (Wrangler) that wraps the API for deploying/managing Workers, plus MCP server support for AI-native access — strong signals of API-first design. However, the evidence pack has no explicit confirmation that every dashboard feature (e.g. some analytics, billing, or newer UI-only features) is fully mirrored in the API, so full UI/API parity isn't directly substantiated.
